grouping.algorithm_contract: connected-component union on registered evidence; do not execute source auditing engine at JM0-B
grouping.unknown_relation: quarantine; cannot assign disjoint merely because no match
grouping.new_family_attestation: different names/seeds alone invalid; justify source/prototype/pool separation and record complete memberships
grouping.inherit: do not weaken saved source audit near-duplicate edges or roundings
grouping.synthetic_caution: same generator family/material pool conservative union; disjoint partition requires actual audited disjoint materials, not random split of old pool

payload.assignment_rule: For every forbidden pair, no shared entity/group/near_duplicate/material/prototype/seed or ancestor. All fields typed; absent relations => UNKNOWN/DEFER, not empty proof. Every child inherits all parent grouping tokens. Freeze before use.

admission.training: exposed sources permitted only in frozen training plan, never eval; legacy branches are not new Jev suffixes
admission.development: may be historically exposed but disjoint from training and between development roles; each use logged
admission.evaluation: closed lifecycle exposure proof, provenance/trust policy, aliases and material closure; never previous JN2/JN3/JN4/negative-analysis source family
admission.synthetic_evaluation: explicit restricted synthetic scope with audited grouped holdout; not independent real-origin evidence
admission.insufficient_groups: DEFER, no seed variants/repeats to fill sources

selection_without_results.order: sort eligible source/material identity digests then task identity digests; round-robin sources; no terminal outcome fields
selection_without_results.missing: do not replace after outcome; freeze smaller bounded set or DEFER before sending

id_rules.canonical: UTF-8 JSON sorted keys compact separators, decimal/unit rules frozen, SHA256
id_rules.new_entity_id: role + full SHA256(parent identities + protocol + generation/selection rule + deterministic ordinal)
id_rules.fork_id: SHA256(public pre-state + full pool + original and forced action + continuation identity + repeat slot)

deadlines.fork_and_repeat_ids: JM1-C1 after allowed public sampling before C2
